title: MOCK_ONLY provisional feature schema — mock_clinical_v2
description: MOCK ONLY. Second placeholder feature schema. It exists to prove the contract's versioned-schema behaviour: a model is bound to exactly one feature schema, and a request that names a schema the model was not built for fails with 422 schema_model_mismatch (Phase 0 §R2-6.2, F-04, F-12). It asserts NO clinical unit, NO feature eligibility ruling and NO medical semantics, and it is not derived from any dataset.
x-dataset-provenance: NONE — synthetic placeholder identifiers, no dataset was acquired, downloaded or read
x-warning: Every unit token below is a schema-local placeholder of the form u_<name>. Placeholder units exist precisely so that no unverified clinical unit (mmHg, mg/dL, bpm, ...) is asserted anywhere in this repository before the data dictionary is ratified.

x-excluded-features.mock_feature_excluded_probe: Excluded from this schema by design (label-adjacent field; Phase 0 §F-1). Supplying it yields 422 feature_not_in_schema.

x-pending-review-features.mock_feature_pending_availability_probe: Pending the feature-availability audit (Phase 0 §F-1, D-027). Supplying it yields 422 feature_not_in_schema.

mock_feature_demographic_age.description: Placeholder age slot. The unit token is a placeholder, not a ratified clinical unit.

mock_feature_demographic_sex.description: Placeholder categorical slot. The source coding is NOT established; no category list is asserted.

mock_feature_fraction.description: Placeholder fractional slot. Required in this schema version.

FeatureValue.title: A single feature assertion
FeatureValue.description: Every numeric feature declares its unit; a unit mismatch is a 422 and is never silently converted (Phase 0 §8.1). A null value means 'not provided' and is treated exactly like an absent feature; a value of 0 is data and is never conflated with missing (Phase 0 §R2-6.2).

entered_by.description: Provenance of the asserted value. Informational only; a patient-entered value becomes inference-eligible only as a clinician-confirmed clinician_entry (Phase 0 §F-4).

UnitTokens.description: Placeholder unit tokens permitted in MOCK_ONLY schemas. Every token matches ^u_[a-z0-9_]+$ so that no clinical unit can be asserted by accident.
